data.summary: The pod startup was slow, taking 39.0 seconds, which breached the 10.0-second SLO. This was primarily due to the application's initialisation phase, which lasted 34.152 seconds. Specifically, the 'init.compute' span took 31.009 seconds because the container was throttled 100% of the time under a low CPU limit of 250m.

findings.statement: The pod took 39.0 seconds to become Ready, exceeding the SLO threshold of 10.0 seconds.
The 'app_init' phase was the longest, contributing 34.152 seconds to the total startup time.
Within the 'app_init' phase, the 'init.compute' span took 31.009 seconds.
The container had a CPU limit of 250m.
The CPU throttling ratio was consistently 1.0 (100%) during the startup period.
